Every buddies trip has a commissioner. Nobody elected him. Nobody thanks him. He does it anyway.

This account is the Office of the Commissioner. Rulings, notices, and the occasional memorandum on how to run a golf trip properly.

Commish keeps the record. Free during launch at commish.golf
